response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile software engineer, but his profile is a fundamental mismatch for this role: no native or apparent Japanese proficiency, no Linux kernel investigation/modification experience, no evidence of embedded networking, security protocols (MACsec, 802.1X), or switch/firmware work, and his recent career trajectory is firmly in web/full-stack and cloud-native development rather than embedded C/UNIX systems.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, senior-level software development experience
Demonstrated systems-level programming background (C/C++ at National Instruments, DLang low-latency work)
Strong communication, teaching, and cross-functional collaboration skills evidenced by talks/workshops
concerns: No indication of Japanese language proficiency, which is a hard requirement
No demonstrated experience with Linux kernel analysis/modification or embedded firmware
No exposure to required security domains (MACsec, 802.1X, tamper detection) or switch/networking hardware

key_factors.factor: No Linux kernel or embedded firmware experience
Lack of network security/switch domain expertise
